title: Banana Survivors
author: The30sclub
selftext:
Hey Guys,   
I am just new here, a d would like to show you my new game in Alpha test period, is possible to test it in Mobile version via Website and PC version via Tesana website. 

Is a Educational Game for Spanish Gamers that wants to play a nice Horde Survival game and learn 1000 vocabulary words! 

A quick Resume from what is about Banana Survivor Project 🍌 🧟‍♀️ 

Banana Survivors is a Spanish language game with English vocabulary woven into it. Every scroll you collect teaches you a word, but the English layer is entirely optional. Play it to learn, or ignore it completely and treat it as what it also is: a hardcore horde survivor with 100 levels, a hero-combo meta, and a timer that will not forgive you.  
A full English translation is coming.

Let me Know in the comment if you want to take a look via mobile or via PC 💪🏽   
Thanks guys!
